obligations.behavior: Enforce strict 1 <= T < HMAC_DRBG_PRIME scalar range in hmac_drbg.sv (rejecting both T == 0 and T >= HMAC_DRBG_PRIME), unconditionally update V_reg <= HMAC_tag in CHCK_ST prior to K3_ST -> V3_ST -> T_ST rejection rounds, keep valid=0 and drbg=0 throughout intermediate/rejection states, latch seed inputs on init_cmd, reject uninstantiated next_cmd and invalid 2'b11 glitches, and sanitize/uninstantiate immediately on zeroize.

obligations.behavior: Pre-clear and write-lock HMAC512_KEY[0..15] and HMAC512_BLOCK[0..31] across KV read, kv_*_data_present, and busy_o lifetimes (preventing trailing 384-bit key residue, CSR_MODE key override, and cycle-15 mid-hash TOCTOU block overwrites), gate core commands on key errors, close 1-cycle KV read/write busy_o and READY gaps, and suppress CSR HMAC512_TAG[0..15] to zero whenever dest_keyvault or KV writeback is active.

Reject sub-word/wider (hsize_i != 3'b010) and unaligned (haddr_i[1:0] != 2'b00) active AHB-Lite transfers with a 2-cycle H_ERROR response while blocking cs/we and zeroing hrdata_o in hmac_ctrl.sv; on ZEROIZE or debugUnlock_or_scan_mode_switch, isolate AHB/CSR key bus in hmac_ctrl.sv and wipe all key/block/tag/kv/lfsr_seed/CSR_MODE/KV_WR_CTRL state while cleanly aborting in-flight operations without hanging ready.
